description: Clip-level lane annotation table for the Malaysian urban and highway driving dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Poh Ping Em. This dataset provides a clip level summary annotation table, lane_clip_annotations.csv, for the 27 video clips released in the companion Malaysian Urban and Highway Driving Dataset by the same author on Mendeley Data (Clip #1 through Clip #27; see the manuscript for the full DOI list). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
